svg.title: The modulation gap
svg.desc: Above about +4 °C outdoor, the house needs less heat than the pump can deliver at its lowest.
svg.text: Above about +4 °C outdoor, the house needs less heat than the pump can deliver at its lowest.
Illustrative: 8 kW design load at −12 °C, heating limit 15 °C, typical inverter air-to-water unit.
